eyebrow: Session B -- a brand-new row appears
code:
-- SESSION B
INSERT INTO Production.Product
  (Name, ProductNumber, ListPrice, ...)
VALUES ('Road Bike, New', 'BK-NEW-01', 799.00, ...);
-- Commits immediately.
caption: A row that didn't exist at all when Session A first queried.

eyebrow: Session A -- same query, different result set
caption: That extra row is the phantom -- not a changed value, a changed SET.

eyebrow: Why REPEATABLE READ can't stop this
titlePlain: It can only lock rows it has

steps.label: REPEATABLE READ
steps.sub: locks existing rows -- but the new row never existed yet

steps.label: SERIALIZABLE
steps.sub: range-locks the whole gap -- the INSERT itself gets blocked

subtitle: The loosest level, where all three anomalies are possible.
